name: SwitchToTabNode
label: Switch To Tab
description: Switches the browser context to a different tab by index, title, or URL fragment.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WebBrowserInstance
fields.label: Browser Instance
fields.description: The active IWebDriver instance representing the browser.

fields.name: SwitchMode
fields.label: Switch Mode
fields.description: The strategy for switching tabs: ByIndex, ByTitle, or ByUrlFragment.

selectOptions.label: By Index
selectOptions.description: Switch to a tab by its zero-based index.

selectOptions.label: By Title
selectOptions.description: Switch to a tab whose title contains the specified text.

selectOptions.label: By URL Fragment
selectOptions.description: Switch to a tab whose URL contains the specified fragment.

fields.name: TabIndex
fields.label: Tab Index
fields.description: The zero-based index of the tab to switch to (used when Switch Mode is ByIndex).

fields.name: TabTitle
fields.label: Tab Title
fields.description: The title (or partial title) of the tab to switch to (used when Switch Mode is ByTitle).

fields.name: UrlFragment
fields.label: URL Fragment
fields.description: A fragment of the URL to match when switching tabs (used when Switch Mode is ByUrlFragment).

fields.name: TimeoutSeconds
fields.label: Timeout (Seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for the tab to become available.

fields.name: CurrentTabTitle
fields.label: Current Tab Title
fields.description: The title of the tab after switching.

fields.name: CurrentTabUrl
fields.label: Current Tab URL
fields.description: The URL of the tab after switching.
